# openmetadata_bot (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata bot. A bot is bound at creation to an existing user that is flagged as a bot (is_bot = true), so create that user first, for example with openmetadata_user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// A bot is bound at creation to an existing user flagged as a bot. Under basic
// auth the server keeps the user name equal to the email local part, so both
// derive from the same prefix.
resource "openmetadata_user" "reporting_bot" {
  name             = "reporting-bot"
  email            = "reporting-bot@example.com"
  is_bot           = true
  jwt_token_expiry = "30"
}

resource "openmetadata_bot" "reporting" {
  name         = "reporting"
  bot_user     = openmetadata_user.reporting_bot.name
  display_name = "Reporting bot"
  description  = "Runs the scheduled reporting workflows."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_user` (String) Name of an existing OpenMetadata user flagged as a bot (is_bot = true). The server binds the bot to this user at creation, so changing it replaces the bot.
- `name` (String) Bot name. Changing it replaces the bot, because the name is also its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the bot.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a bot this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_bot.reporting 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a bot is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_bot.reporting reporting
```
